Stage local files for the next push.

Panel: [Collection](/docs/reference/cli/panels/collection/).

## Usage

```text
huron add [OPTIONS] PATHS...
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description                                                                |
| -------- | ---- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `PATHS`  | path | Local files or directories to stage. Required. Takes any number of values. |

## Options

| Option              | Type | Default | Description                             |
| ------------------- | ---- | ------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `--as`              | str  |         | The path of the file in the collection. |
| `--recursive`, `-r` | flag |         | Stage directories.                      |
